name: Robot Mutiny
description: Every BattleBot troop galaxy-wide is wired to one hidden transmitter on a ruin world. Robot garrisons quietly build hidden sleeper robots. When the broadcast wakes, colonies rise wherever their robots can win; the first captured colony makes the machines a full empire, and the transmitter spawns warships a tech level ahead of the best empire until it is silenced. The Broadcast fleet is sized to the strongest normal empire's military: about 1.3x its firepower in the first year, growing 0.1x a year (cap 1.8x) while the source stands; losses are replaced, nothing more. At the rising every BattleBot garrison defects, it starts at tech level 5, is at war with everyone for good, and either takes an eighth of the Ancient Guardians' fleet, 30 troop transports and 3 founded worlds and attacks the weakest-garrisoned colonies near the transmitter, or (1 in 5) absorbs the whole of the Guardians and turtles: building stations and defending them, never sending fleets beyond them.
